column1: # Every place "open source" / "OSS" may legitimately appear in the documentation
# tree. AxonFlow Community is BSL 1.1 SOURCE-AVAILABLE and must never be called
# open source (CLAUDE.md hard rule; technical-docs/README.md rule 4).
# An occurrence not listed here fails licensing_wording_test.sh. An entry here
# whose file no longer contains that text ALSO fails, so the list cannot rot
# into a blanket exemption for a file.
# Columns: path <TAB> reason <TAB> the exact substring that must be present
# Every entry falls into one of three classes, and no other class is acceptable:
#   third-party   the phrase describes somebody else's product
#   bsl-sunset    the BSL 1.1 change-date conversion, which is a real future fact
#   our-own-rule  a document stating or applying this rule, including a [sic]
#                 quotation of wording that was wrong when it was written
